{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify conversion is binary
assert df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "'converted' column contains non-binary values"

# Compute conversion rate for email
total_email = df[df['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
converted_email = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
rate_email = converted_email / total_email

# Compute conversion rate for paid_search
total_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]
converted_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search / total_paid_search

# Compute difference in conversion rates
difference = rate_email - rate_paid_search

# Print results
print(f"Email conversion rate: {rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")

# Return the difference
rate_email, rate_paid_search, difference"}
